text:
tara: quick postmortem from today's int8 bringup for atlas-30b. we have a deterministic divergence vs fp16 exactly when the logical context surpasses 131072 tokens (128k). minimal repro attached.

rui: that's a new boundary for us. what's the symptom and where does it appear?

tara: running on a single H100 with seed=11, seq=132000. with `--quant=int8 --prefill=true` we see: 
```
ERR: rotary_phase_mismatch at global_pos=131072 layer=20 expected 0x9b4f got 0x9b50
INFO: prefill flush at 131072, kv_phys_idx=131080, pad_prefix=8
WARN: ropescale adjusted due to phys_idx >= 131072
```

emily: so phys_idx != logical_idx again. did atlas change packing recently?

tara: yes, pack_align=16 was enabled for int8 kernels in commit ae9f2c to improve memcpy alignment. fp16 path uses contiguous layout so no issue.

gleb: quick check: `--no-cache` makes int8 match fp16 exactly. with cache enabled mismatch shows at the token crossing 131072 every run.

kv-bot: test-run 1849999999 by tara atlas-30b / int8 / cuda:0 / seq=132000 / dump-kv-levels=1. Result: mismatch at layer=20 kv_global_idx=131072 pad=8.

rui: pattern matches other pad-induced mismatches we've seen but at a higher border. likely cumulative pad across shards causes logical vs physical divergence once global_pos crosses 2^17. we should compute logical_pos = phys_pos - prefix_pad_sum when deriving rotary phase.

emily: I'm worried about subtle downstream drift. propose steps: (1) add a unit test that fills 132k tokens and asserts per-layer rope phase parity int8 vs fp16; (2) quick patch in runtime/rotary.cc to subtract cumulative pad before ropescale; (3) run LLMQA long-window sweep comparing int8 vs fp16 for atlas and two smaller models.

tara: I've written the reproducer: `tools/repro/long_kv_run.py --model atlas-30b --quant int8 --seq 132000 --dump-kv`. I'll push the failing test (tests/longctx/test_atlas_132k.py) and the dump to a draft PR.

gleb: bisect shows commit ae9f2c introduced pack_align=16 behavior; older commit af3b11 doesn't reproduce. linking bisect: //ci/bisect/ae9f2c..af3b11.

emily: short-term mitigation for on-prem: runtime config `pack_align=0` reverts to contiguous layout and avoids the regression (perf regresses ~1.8%). we should document as temporary flag for Private installs.

kv-bot: task created ENGML-3255 add failing longctx test and bisect notes; ENGML-3256 rotary-index patch; ENGML-3257 nightly long-window quant-vs-fp sweep.

rui: implementation note: watch out for negative logical_pos when multiple pads exist per-shard; clamp or assert. also update comments in pack code so future pack authors know rotor math depends on logical indices.

tara: plan: tara will open draft PR w/ reproducer and test; gleb will prototype small patch subtracting prefix pad before ropescale; emily will add opportunistic LLMQA job to run after PR merges. aim to land patch early next week.

emily: also adding a line to the model onboarding checklist: "run long-context parity test at >8k/32k/128k for any quantized kernel on initial bring-up". that'll catch these earlier.

tara: thanks team. dropping the repro link and KV dumps in the PR. :thumbsup:
